storyCards.headline: I Love A Rainy Night: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Eddie Rabbitt's "I Love A Rainy Night" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I Love a Rainy Night" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music artist Eddie Rabbitt.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 28 weeks on the chart.

I Love A Rainy Night was released in 1980.

"I Love A Rainy Night" by Eddie Rabbitt.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
